hooks.logic:
Count up "intervalTurn".
If the register's 'isEndressHaste', then
  If the enemy has the HASTE status, then the enemy gains the HASTE status.
  Otherwise, set the register's 'isEndressHaste' to false.
If condition flag "on_damage" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'onDamagedCount' by one.
If condition flag "wave_cannon_done" is up this frame, then set the register's 'onDamagedCount' to 0.
If condition flag "blaster_done" is up this frame, then reset the count "intervalTurn".
Let bpConfsIndex be the register's 'bpConfsIndex'.
Let v2 be run helper2.
If bpConfsIndex is not v2, then
  Run helper on v2.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let number be the numeric entry "count_of_on_damage_to_actuate_wave_cannon" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If the register's 'onDamagedCount' is at least number, then the enemy uses the move labelled "wave_cannon" and stop.
  If list at (the register's 'bpConfsIndex')'s 'paramSuffixNo' is "1", then
    Let v3 be run helper3.
    Let v4 be the count "intervalTurn".
    Let number2 be the numeric entry "turns_of_blaster_interval" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
    If the length of v3 is not 0 and v4 is more than number2, then the enemy uses the move labelled "blaster" with options {activeTarget: v3 at 0} and stop.
  The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
